description: In distributed consensus protocols with explicit finalization mechanisms (BFT protocols, PoS with finality gadgets like Casper FFG, PBFT variants), the finalized block height must be monotonically non-decreasing. Once a block at height H is finalized, no block at height < H should ever be finalized in the future.
trigger_condition: A Byzantine or compromised consensus layer client sends state update messages (e.g., ForkchoiceUpdated, SetHead, Finalize) that attempt to move the finalized block pointer to a block at a lower height than the currently finalized block, violating the monotonicity property of finalization.
